## Single and Multiple Imputation Using `mice` (Ref: Van Buuren 2011)

```{r}
set.seed(214)

train_index <- sample(1:nrow(framing), 0.7 * nrow(framing))

train_data <- framing[train_index, ]
test_data  <- framing[-train_index, ]
```


```{r}
train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(
    BPMeds = factor(BPMeds),                       # binary with missingness
    education = ordered(education, levels = 1:4)   # ordinal with missingness
  )

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    BPMeds = factor(BPMeds),                       # binary with missingness
    education = ordered(education, levels = 1:4)   # ordinal with missingness
  )

```

```{r}
framing_to_impute <- train_data

init <- mice(framing_to_impute, maxit = 0, print = FALSE)
meth <- init$method
pred <- init$predictorMatrix

# Explicit methods
meth[] <- ""
meth["cigsPerDay"] <- "norm"
meth["BPMeds"] <- "logreg"
meth["education"] <- "polr"
meth["totChol"] <- "norm"
meth["BMI"] <- "norm"
meth["heartRate"] <- "norm"
meth["glucose"] <- "norm"
meth["TenYearCHD"] <- ""  # do not impute outcome

# Ensure outcome is not imputed but can be used to predict other variables
pred["TenYearCHD", ] <- 0

meth
pred
```

Train Imputation
```{r}
framing_imputed_train <- mice(
  data = train_data,
  m = 20,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  seed = 214,
  maxit = 5,
  print = FALSE
)

train_complete <- complete(framing_imputed_train)
```

Test Imputation

```{r}
#drop tenyearCHd being used in test impuation
pred_test <- pred
pred_test[, "TenYearCHD"] <- 0

framing_imputed_test <- mice(
  data = test_data,
  m = 20,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred_test,
  seed = 214,
  maxit = 5,
  print = FALSE
)

test_complete <- complete(framing_imputed_test)
```


```{r}
# Keep one completed dataset for diagnostics/plots and models that use a single dataset
train_complete <- complete(framing_imputed_train, action = 1)
test_complete  <- complete(framing_imputed_test, action = 1)

# Also keep all completed datasets for MI prediction pooling in tree-based models
train_all <- complete(framing_imputed_train, action = "all")
test_all  <- complete(framing_imputed_test, action = "all")
```


```{r}

plot(framing_imputed_train)
```


```{r}
#Changing to factor so tree isnt a regression but classification tree
train_complete$TenYearCHD <- factor(train_complete$TenYearCHD)
test_complete$TenYearCHD  <- factor(test_complete$TenYearCHD)

for (i in seq_along(train_all)) {
  train_all[[i]]$TenYearCHD <- factor(train_all[[i]]$TenYearCHD, levels = c(0, 1))
  test_all[[i]]$TenYearCHD  <- factor(test_all[[i]]$TenYearCHD, levels = c(0, 1))
}
```

##############################################################################################

Naive tree
```{r}
library(tree)

# Fit one tree per imputed dataset and pool test predictions
tree_prob_list <- vector("list", length(train_all))
for (i in seq_along(train_all)) {
  tree_fit_i <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ ., data = train_all[[i]])
  p_i <- predict(tree_fit_i, newdata = test_all[[i]], type = "vector")
  tree_prob_list[[i]] <- p_i[, "1"]
}

tree_prob <- Reduce(`+`, tree_prob_list) / length(tree_prob_list)
tree.pred <- factor(ifelse(tree_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1))
tree_actual <- test_all[[1]]$TenYearCHD

tree_cm <- table(Predicted = tree.pred, Actual = tree_actual)
tree_cm

tree_accuracy <- mean(tree.pred == tree_actual)
tree_misclass <- 1 - tree_accuracy
tree_sensitivity <- tree_cm["1", "1"] / sum(tree_cm[, "1"])
tree_specificity <- tree_cm["0", "0"] / sum(tree_cm[, "0"])

c(
  Accuracy = tree_accuracy,
  Misclassification = tree_misclass,
  Sensitivity = tree_sensitivity,
  Specificity = tree_specificity
)
```

```{r}
# Example tree from the first imputed training dataset
tree.model <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ ., data = train_all[[1]])
plot(tree.model)
text(tree.model, pretty = 0, cex = 0.7)
```

```{r}

# Convert actual to numeric (0/1)
tree_actual_num <- as.numeric(as.character(tree_actual))

# ROC object
tree_roc <- roc(tree_actual_num, tree_prob)

# AUC
auc_value_tree <- auc(tree_roc)

# Plot
plot(tree_roc, col = "blue", lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve - Naive Tree")
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")
text(0.6, 0.2, paste("AUC =", round(auc_value_tree, 3)))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(prob = tree_prob, actual = tree_actual_num),
       aes(x = prob, y = actual)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration Curve (LOESS) - Naive Tree",
    x = "Predicted Probability",
    y = "Observed Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
#Brier
mean((tree_prob - tree_actual_num)^2)
```

```{r}
cv.framing

best_size

prune.fram <- prune.tree(tree.model, best = 3)


plot(prune.fram)
text(prune.fram, pretty = 0)
```

```{r chunk10}

tree_prob <- predict(prune.fram, newdata = test_complete, type = "vector")[, "1"]

tree_actual_num_prune <- as.numeric(as.character(tree_actual))
```

```{r}
c(
  Accuracy = tree_accuracy,
  Misclassification = tree_misclass,
  Sensitivity = tree_sensitivity,
  Specificity = tree_specificity
)


```

##############################################################################################
Random Forest
```{r}

library(randomForest)
rf_m <- min(10, length(train_all))   # use first 10 imputations for RF pooling
rf_ntree <- 200 # fewer trees per forest

#train m models on m complete data sets:
rf <- NULL
for (m in seq_len(rf_m)) {
  rf[[m]] <- randomForest(
    TenYearCHD ~ .,
    data = train_all[[m]],
    ntree = rf_ntree
  )
}

```

```{r}
#Pooling Votes from Each model
rf_prob_list <- list() 

for (m in seq_along(rf)) {
  test_x_m <- test_all[[m]] %>% select(-TenYearCHD)
  
  rf_prob_list[[m]] <- predict(rf[[m]], test_x_m, type = "prob")[, "1"]  
}
rf_prob <- Reduce(`+`, rf_prob_list) / length(rf_prob_list)


rf_pred <- factor(ifelse(rf_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1))

rf_actual <- factor(test_all[[1]]$TenYearCHD, levels = c(0, 1))
rf_actual_num <- as.numeric(as.character(rf_actual))
                    
#############                   
    
Framing.rf <- randomForest(
  TenYearCHD ~ .,
  data = train_all[[1]],
  ntree = rf_ntree,
  importance = TRUE,
  proximity = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
rf_cm <- table(Predicted = rf_pred, Actual = rf_actual)
rf_cm

rf_accuracy <- mean(rf_pred == rf_actual)
rf_misclass <- 1 - rf_accuracy
rf_sensitivity <- if (sum(rf_cm[, "1"]) > 0) rf_cm["1", "1"] / sum(rf_cm[, "1"]) else NA_real_
rf_specificity <- if (sum(rf_cm[, "0"]) > 0) rf_cm["0", "0"] / sum(rf_cm[, "0"]) else NA_real_
rf_oob_error <- Framing.rf$err.rate[nrow(Framing.rf$err.rate), "OOB"]

c(
  Accuracy = rf_accuracy,
  Misclassification = rf_misclass,
  Sensitivity = rf_sensitivity,
  Specificity = rf_specificity,
  OOB_Error = rf_oob_error
)
```

```{r}
# OOB error at final tree
Framing.rf$err.rate[nrow(Framing.rf$err.rate), "OOB"]
```

Improving varimpplot for presentation

```{r}
imp <- as.data.frame(imp) 
imp$varnames <- rownames(imp)
rownames(imp) <- NULL

imp$var_categ <- "All"

Importance_plot <- ggplot(imp, aes(
  x = reorder(varnames, MeanDecreaseGini),
  y = MeanDecreaseGini,
  color = var_categ
)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#a80050", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = varnames, xend = varnames, y = 0, yend = MeanDecreaseGini),
               linewidth = .7,
               color = "#a80050") +
  ylab("MeanDecreaseGini") + 
  xlab("Variable") +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Variable Importance") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

  
```

##############################################################################################

Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART)
```{r}
library(BART)

xtrain <- model.matrix(TenYearCHD ~ ., data = train_complete)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
xtest  <- model.matrix(TenYearCHD ~ ., data = test_complete)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

ytrain <- as.numeric(as.character(train_complete$TenYearCHD))

set.seed(1)
bartfit <- pbart(x.train = xtrain, y.train = ytrain, x.test = xtest)

bart_prob <- bartfit$prob.test.mean
bart_actual <- factor(test_complete$TenYearCHD, levels = c(0, 1))
bart_pred <- factor(ifelse(bart_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1))
```

```{r}
# Predicted probability of CHD=1
bart_cm <- table(Predicted = bart_pred, Actual = bart_actual)
bart_cm

bart_accuracy <- mean(bart_pred == bart_actual)
bart_misclass <- 1 - bart_accuracy
bart_sensitivity <- bart_cm["1", "1"] / sum(bart_cm[, "1"])
bart_specificity <- bart_cm["0", "0"] / sum(bart_cm[, "0"])
```

```{r}

bart_actual_num <- as.numeric(as.character(bart_actual))
bart_roc <- roc(bart_actual_num, bart_prob)

plot(bart_roc, col = "purple", lwd = 2,
     main = "ROC Curve - BART")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

auc_value_bart <- auc(bart_roc)
text(0.6, 0.2, paste("AUC =", round(auc_value_bart, 3)))


```


```{r}
ggplot(data.frame(prob = bart_prob, actual = bart_actual_num),
       aes(x = prob, y = actual)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "purple", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration Curve - BART",
    x = "Predicted Probability",
    y = "Observed Probability"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()
```

#############################################
Table + Plots for Presentation

```{r}
# Save reusable plot/data objects for presentation
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)

results_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Pruned Tree", "Random Forest", "BART"),
  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(auc(tree_prune_roc)),
    as.numeric(auc(rf_roc)),
    as.numeric(auc(bart_roc))
  ),
  Brier = c(
    mean((tree_prob - tree_actual_num_prune)^2),
    mean((rf_prob - rf_actual_num)^2),
    mean((bart_prob - bart_actual_num)^2)
  ),
  MC_Error = c(
    tree_misclass,
    rf_misclass,
    bart_misclass
  )
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

```{r}
results_summary_long <- data.frame(
  Model = rep(results_summary$Model, each = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("AUC", "Brier", "MC Error"), times = nrow(results_summary)),
  Value = c(t(as.matrix(results_summary[, c("AUC", "Brier", "MC_Error")]))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

results_summary_plot <- ggplot(results_summary_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Model, fill = Value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Value)), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0f8ff", high = "#a80050") +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison: AUC, Brier, MC Error", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

roc_curves_plot <- pROC::ggroc(
  list("Pruned Tree" = tree_prune_roc, "Random Forest" = rf_roc, "BART" = bart_roc),
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  linewidth = 1.2
) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pruned Tree" = "blue", "Random Forest" = "darkgreen", "BART" = "purple")) +
  labs(title = "ROC Curves", x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", color = "Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

bart_calibration_df <- data.frame(
  prob = bart_prob,
  actual = bart_actual_num,
  Model = "BART"
)

calibration_plot <- ggplot(bart_calibration_df, aes(x = prob, y = actual)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2, color = "purple") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "Calibration Curve - BART", x = "Predicted Probability", y = "Observed Probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

saveRDS(Importance_plot, "importance_plot_obj.rds")
saveRDS(results_summary_plot, "results_summary_plot_obj.rds")
saveRDS(roc_curves_plot, "roc_curves_plot_obj.rds")
saveRDS(calibration_plot, "calibration_plot_obj.rds")

saveRDS(
  list(
    results_summary = results_summary,
    tree_prune_roc = tree_prune_roc,
    rf_roc = rf_roc,
    bart_roc = bart_roc,
    bart_calibration_df = bart_calibration_df
  ),
  "model_results_objects.rds"
)

results_summary
```
